**“I would first confirm the diagnosis using the appropriate diagnostic criteria and assess whether this represents GDM or overt diabetes. I would assess maternal risk factors and complications, then begin dietary and lifestyle modification with self-monitoring of blood glucose and appropriate glycaemic targets. If targets are not achieved, I would initiate pharmacological therapy, such as metformin and/or insulin according to local guidelines. I would monitor fetal growth and wellbeing, particularly for macrosomia and polyhydramnios, and counsel regarding shoulder dystocia and delivery options. During labour I would monitor maternal glucose and fetal wellbeing and prepare for complications. Postpartum, I would reassess glucose because insulin resistance usually falls after delivery and arrange appropriate postpartum diabetes testing because of the increased long-term risk of type 2 diabetes.”**
